subject: Pilot funding and co-sell onboarding — Datadog & Observify
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erica Lang <erica.lang@datadog.com>, Paul Nguyen <paul@observify.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot funding and co-sell onboarding — Datadog & Observify

Hi Erica and Paul,

Quick note to kick off a lightweight pilot + co-sell path we discussed on the call. Goal: validate the Datadog + Redwood OTLP integration in a joint pilot with Observify, then convert into a co-sell package for a small set of mutual target accounts.

Ask: can Datadog commit a $25k pilot marketing/integration fund and nominate one SE to help with a 4-week technical validation window? Observify is ready to run a customer pilot with one enterprise customer (has signed an NDA).

What we'll deliver from Redwood:
- Pilot SOW and success criteria (technical + commercial)
- Integration checklist and an integration demo to package for enablement
- Co-sell enablement doc and 1-hour joint webinar for field

I attached a draft SOW and the integration checklist for initial review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Datadog confirms fund + SE support by next Tue (6/1)
2) We finalize SOW and kick pilot week of 6/7
3) Agree on 3 acceptance metrics (latency, ingestion rate, dashboard coverage)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: pilot-sow-draft.pdf (PDF), datadog-integration-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Paul Nguyen <paul@observify.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Erica Lang <erica.lang@datadog.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T09:51:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot funding and co-sell onboarding — Datadog & Observify

Thanks Ben — excited to move. Quick answers from Observify:
- We can run the pilot customer (name on request once NDA processed)
- Observify can cover the customer-facing implementation hours; funding request is specifically for co-marketing and SE time from Datadog to accelerate the validation on their side.

Couple of asks for the SOW:
- Add a short confidentiality clause that references the existing NDA (we can attach).
- Include a basic go/no-go decision checkpoint after week 2 with defined acceptance metrics.

Would expect to be able to start the week of 6/7 if we lock these pieces down this week.

—Paul
Paul Nguyen | Head of Integrations | Observify
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erica Lang <erica.lang@datadog.com>, Paul Nguyen <paul@observify.io>
Date: 2027-05-28T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot funding and co-sell onboarding — Datadog & Observify

Ben — looping to confirm commercial approvals on our side. A couple of internal notes:
- We should cap the pilot at 30 days and define the three metrics Paul suggested.
- I'll prepare a short mutual action plan (MAP) template that assigns owners and dates.

Connor: can you draft a minimal MAP and milestone list today so Ben can push to Datadog?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Field Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Erica Lang <erica.lang@datadog.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Paul Nguyen <paul@observify.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot funding and co-sell onboarding — Datadog & Observify

Thanks for the clear plan. A few items from Datadog security & field enablement:
- We can support $25k in co-marketing funds and will provision an SE for 20 hours during the validation window.
- Security asks: we need our standard evidence (SOC 2 scope summary, data flow diagram for telemetry, and retention policy). Can Redwood produce an abbreviated security pack (PDF) and confirm that no PII will be forwarded during pilot?
- We'll need a short license addendum for the pilot (60-day trial terms).

Attaching: security-evidence-summary.pdf (stub). I also attached a redline template for the license addendum; please review and send back.

If the above is OK, I can prepare a short internal PR to get the marketing funds released next week.

Best,
Erica Lang
Senior Partner Manager | Datadog
attachments: security-evidence-summary.pdf (PDF)
